name: Enthalpy v0.4.36
notes:
# Enthalpy v0.4.36

## Changes

- The Dashboard opens existing Daily notes that have date-only file names.
- Daily note creation and task creation use an existing note for the selected
  date. They do not create a second note with a different file name.
- When two Daily notes use the same date, the Dashboard shows a conflict and
  links to both files. Both files stay unchanged.
- Rapid day selection keeps the last selected day after pending saves finish.
- Application notifications close automatically and have a close button.

## Test this preview

Select an earlier day with a saved Daily note. Confirm that its content opens.
Edit the note, select another day, and return. Confirm that the edit remains.

If the Dashboard reports two notes for one date, open each file from the
message and check its content. Enthalpy does not combine or delete these files.

## Known limits

This is a limited preview. Hosted Sync is not available. Work stays on this
device.
